message.content: {"sentences":[{"text":"Meta launched two AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which it says rival leading models from OpenAI and Anthropic, covered by 6 outlets.","ids":["a1","a2","a3"],"quote":{"id":"a1","span":"Meta launched two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full"}},{"text":"Meta says the largest Muse Wonder version outperforms Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 and ranks just below Claude Opus 5.5 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.","ids":["a2"],"quote":{"id":"a2","span":"outperforms Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 and ranks just below Claude Opus 5.5"}},{"text":"Cloudflare released Clef-omni, which accepts audio, video, image, and text input, and says it is built on a Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct mixture-of-experts foundation.","ids":["a4"],"quote":{"id":"a4","span":"Cloudflare released Clef-omni, which accepts audio, video, image, and text input"}},{"text":"Sakana AI's MASS method lets one language model improve itself by solving, judging, and refining workflows without a stronger teacher, though shared blind spots can let errors pass as progress.","ids":["a9"],"quote":{"id":"a9","span":"lets one language model improve itself by solving, judging, and refining workflows without a stronger teacher"}}]}

{"sentences":[{"text":"Google released Gemini 4 Argon worldwide, with the company claiming it ranks first on the Vals Index and pricing it at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.","ids":["a1","a2","a3"],"quote":{"id":"a2","span":"Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available"}},{"text":"Meta introduced the Muse Wonder series, and the full version ranks second behind Anthropic's Opus 5.5 in Artificial Analysis intelligence rankings, according to a newsletter summary.","ids":["a5","a6"],"quote":{"id":"a6","span":"the full version ranking second behind Anthropic's Opus 5.5 in Artificial Analysis intelligence rankings"}},{"text":"An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company said it found a hidden recording device in a conference room, and prosecutors said it was inserted into a TV's USB port.","ids":["a7","a8","a9"],"quote":{"id":"a8","span":"OpenAI caught the device after it was inserted into a USB port on the back of a television"}},{"text":"Rivian's industrial AI and robotics venture Mind Robotics hired former Ford EV chief Doug Field as president, according to TechCrunch.","ids":["a10","a11"],"quote":{"id":"a11","span":"Rivian hired former Ford EV chief Doug Field as president of its industrial AI and robotics venture Mind Robotics"}},{"text":"Google said users can now run private, vibe-coded apps on Android through Google Play without publishing them publicly.","ids":["a12","a13"],"quote":{"id":"a12","span":"users can now run private, vibe-coded apps on Android via Google Play without publishing them publicly"}}]}

{"sentences":[{"text":"Google released Gemini 4 Argon worldwide, with an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, covered by 6 outlets.","ids":["a2","a1","a3"],"quote":{"id":"a2","span":"introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens"}},{"text":"Meta introduced the Muse Wonder series, with Muse Wonder Full ranking second behind Anthropic's Opus 5.5 in Artificial Analysis intelligence rankings, covered by 3 outlets.","ids":["a5","a6"],"quote":{"id":"a6","span":"ranking second behind Anthropic's Opus 5.5 in Artificial Analysis intelligence rankings"}},{"text":"An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company said it found a hidden recording device in a conference room, covered by 3 outlets.","ids":["a7","a8","a9"],"quote":{"id":"a7","span":"discovered a sophisticated recording device hidden in one of its offices"}},{"text":"Rivian partner Mind Robotics hired Doug Field as president, according to the startup, covered by 2 outlets.","ids":["a10","a11"],"quote":{"id":"a10","span":"hired Doug Field as president to lead its robotics effort"}},{"text":"Google Play now lets users run private, vibe-coded apps on Android without publishing them publicly, covered by 2 outlets.","ids":["a12","a13"],"quote":{"id":"a12","span":"run private, vibe-coded apps on Android via Google Play without publishing them publicly"}}]}
